text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A Tenno Sho (Spring) where everyone fought 
with their resolve and pride on the line; 
the one who emerged victorious in that 
contest was Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the defeated rivals wore refreshed 
expressions. Their faces clearly showed 
they had given everything they had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that look on their face brought 
certainty: "To convey the Marvelous 
through racing." That wish had been 
thoroughly fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can't stop here. Let's give it our all 
toward the finale of the Spring Senior 
Triple Crown, the Takarazuka Kinen.
